census.e8_to_wait_helper_note: Shared helper: 474 direct E8 call sites across the binary (objdump-mnemonic confirmed, all rel32-verified); the two #250 caller-B sites are members, not the whole census.

wt_acct.shows: Slow-path accounting: max-now indirect call, copies, elapsed subtract, slow-count bump, total add, compare, max store, ticket high-water

wt_entry.shows: Entry: endbr64, pushes, arg save, mutex lea +0x40, canary, spin-disable global test

wt_exit.shows: Exit block: waiter decrement + jump to success, negative-compare copy path, stack-check failure call

wt_slow.shows: Slow path: deadline helper, copy, ticket xadd, trylock, blocking lock, contended flag set, waiter decrement, GOT lea

wt_spin.shows: Spin loop: global spin-limit test, pause, contended-flag test, trylock, success-count bump

arg_layout.+0x00: total waited nanoseconds (slow path only, accumulated)
arg_layout.+0x18: successful acquisition count (fast and slow exits)
arg_layout.+0x24: live waiter count (xadd inc, lock sub dec)
arg_layout.+0x68: contended flag byte (set after blocking lock, tested in spin loop)

function.arg_role: pointer to a lock-waiter record; the mutex lives at arg+0x40
function.entry: endbr64, rdi->r12 (arg), rbp = arg+0x40 (mutex), push r14/r13/r12/rbp/rbx

globals.spin_limit_data: 0x64ffc98 (.data, file-backed): spin while == -1 or > spin count, else slow path

internal_calls.0x63bf77d: indirect via GOT slot 0x64df1e8 -> 0x63bfa70 max-now helper
